tools.name: public-infrastructure_ip-to-asn-lookup
tools.description: Longest-prefix match against a vendored RouteViews BGP snapshot, with IANA special-purpose flags. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-infrastructure/ip-to-asn-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-infrastructure_iana-tld-rdap-bootstrap
tools.description: Return IANA RDAP base URLs for a domain, IP or ASN from the vendored bootstrap registries. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-infrastructure/iana-tld-rdap-bootstrap. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-infrastructure_travel-advisory-lookup
tools.description: Return State Department and FCDO travel advice for a country side by side. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-infrastructure/travel-advisory-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-infrastructure_visa-waiver-list-lookup
tools.description: Check whether a nationality appears on the DHS Visa Waiver Program or UK VN 1.1(a) lists. Price $0.01 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-infrastructure/visa-waiver-list-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-infrastructure_ofsted-rating-lookup
tools.description: Look up the latest Ofsted inspection outcomes for a state-funded school in England. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-infrastructure/ofsted-rating-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-infrastructure_college-scorecard-lookup
tools.description: Look up cost, admission, completion, earnings and debt fields from the College Scorecard. Price $0.02 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-infrastructure/college-scorecard-lookup. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-infrastructure_grants-gov-opportunity-search
tools.description: Search open US federal grant synopses and forecasts from the Grants.gov daily extract. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-infrastructure/grants-gov-opportunity-search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public-infrastructure" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: public-infrastructure_visa-waiver-list-lookup, public-infrastructure_grants-gov-opportunity-search · Public sink: public-infrastructure_ip-to-asn-lookup, public-infrastructure_iana-tld-rdap-bootstrap, public-infrastructure_travel-advisory-lookup, public-infrastructure_visa-waiver-list-lookup, public-infrastructure_ofsted-rating-lookup, public-infrastructure_college-scorecard-lookup, public-infrastructure_grants-gov-opportunity-search · Destructive: public-infrastructure_ip-to-asn-lookup, public-infrastructure_iana-tld-rdap-bootstrap, public-infrastructure_travel-advisory-lookup, public-infrastructure_visa-waiver-list-lookup, public-infrastructure_ofsted-rating-lookup, public-infrastructure_college-scorecard-lookup, public-infrastructure_grants-gov-opportunity-search.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
